list.name: dc
list.label: DC
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "dc", predicate: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^dtfs_/, start: -7d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "dc", predicate: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^dtfs_/, start: -7d)

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "node", predicate: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^dtfs_/ and contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}), start: -7d)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "node", predicate: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^dtfs_/ and contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}), start: -7d)

panels.title: Managers reporting
panels.description: Managers that pushed a point in the last minute; expect your configured manager count (3). Red means no manager reports.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_is_leader" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_stop"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: r._stop, _field: "managers"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Data nodes reporting
panels.description: Data nodes that pushed a point in the last minute. Fewer than deployed means a node is down or cannot push metrics.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_mem_rss_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_stop"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: r._stop, _field: "data nodes"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Leader changes
panels.description: Raft leader changes over the selected range (highest count seen by any manager). 0 is normal; repeated changes mean flapping.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_leader_changes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> spread()
  |> group(columns: ["_stop"])
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _time: r._stop, _field: "leader changes"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Disks failed

panels.title: Raft leader per manager
panels.description: Which manager is Raft leader over time: exactly one manager should show leader at any moment. A stretch with none means no quorum.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_is_leader" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "leader " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Memory pressure per node

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_memory_pressure_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "manager " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_mem_pressure_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Cluster throughput (FUSE)
panels.description: Chunk bytes per second moved by all FUSE clients: write is PutChunk, read is GetChunk, summed across clients. Includes every replica copy a client sends.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_put_chunk_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "write")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_get_chunk_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "read")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Data node throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second stored (put) and served (get) per data node, summed over its disks. Shows where load lands.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_put_bytes_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "put")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r._field + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_get_bytes_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "get")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r._field + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: FUSE read and write p99
panels.description: 99th percentile latency of FUSE read and write calls per client (per push interval, coarse). Sustained rises mean slow replicas or a saturated link.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_op_us" and r._field == "p99" and (r.op == "read" or r.op == "write"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["node", "op"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "p99 " + r.op + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Raft write p99 per manager

from(bucket: "${bucket}")

  |> group(columns: ["node"])

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Fill level of each data disk (used over total); yellow from 80 percent, red from 90 percent. The disk that fills first is the one to act on.

targets.query:
used = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node", "disk"])
  |> group(columns: ["node", "disk"])

total = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_disk_total_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node", "disk"])
  |> group(columns: ["node", "disk"])

join(tables: {u: used, t: total}, on: ["_time", "node", "disk"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value_t > 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value_u) / float(v: r._value_t), _field: r.node + " " + r.disk}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: RSS vs budget

rss = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_memory_rss_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "node"])
  |> group(columns: ["node"])

cap = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_memory_hard_cap_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value_r) / float(v: r._value_c), _field: r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

rss = from(bucket: "${bucket}")

cap = from(bucket: "${bucket}")

panels.title: Raft follower lag (max)
panels.description: Log entries each follower is behind the leader, per peer (the leader exports it, other managers report 0). Should hover near 0; a growing line means a slow or partitioned follower.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_follower_lag" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["peer"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "lag " + r.peer}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
